other_conditions: The worker must be registered under the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
The worker must have a minimum of one‑year regular membership.
The dependent child must have a disability certificate of 50% or more physical/mental disability issued by the District Medical Board.
The dependent child's name must be included in the ration card.
The dependent child must not have availed the scheme benefit in the current financial year from any other Haryana Government Department/Board/Corporation.
The dependent child must not have any source of income.
The dependent child must not be married.
A live certificate of the dependent child must be submitted/uploaded every year to continue receiving assistance.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2000 per month is provided to eligible disabled children of registered construction workers.
documents_required: Disability certificate of the dependent child issued by the District Medical Board
Live certificate of the dependent child (annual)
Ration card showing the dependent child's name
